name: component_recombination_generate_pilot_10
description: Two ComUIBench-style Vue seeds per component capability profile. Each seed produces one new complete Generate GT by adding a semantically coherent route composed from existing components.

seeds.target_hint: Add a comparison or curation page that combines the existing repeated product family, shared shell, and member-side state.
Add a decision-support page that recomposes existing schedule, athlete, or readiness components and preserves the shared navigation/state model.
Add a curated showcase page that combines two existing reusable card families in one new editorial composition.
Add a visit-planning page that reuses the botanical card family in a new density/layout variant and connects to existing itinerary state.
Add an accommodation-planning page assembled from existing accessible cards, form primitives, status components, and global preference state.
Add an observing-plan page that recomposes existing forms, information cards, and schedule/state modules into a coherent offline workflow.
Add a connection-planning page that reuses the existing badge, card, modal, button, and navigation design-system primitives.
Add a family itinerary page built from existing event, schedule, saved-item, and shared shell components without introducing a second visual language.
Add a maintenance queue page that reuses equipment cards, accordion/status patterns, shared role state, and the existing shell.
Add a collection comparison page by recomposing existing instrument, metadata, filter, and saved-collection components.
